messages:
carla.eng: Heads up - manager wants to promote an IC who moved internal 2025-02-02 (US->US) and asks for salary effective 2025-02-01. Is that automatic?

maya.hr: If transfer was after the cycle cutoff, not automatic. But we can do exceptions. What's the requested retro length?

carla.eng: 1 day retro. Manager says its more about start of month alignment.

zack.payroll: One-day retro is easy. We can include it in the next payroll without off-cycle if submitted before payroll cutoff and coded correctly. Just include the exact effective date and GL code.

oliver.comp: Comp note: very small retros (days) are fine. If band placement changes, we still need the evidence packet but this might be handled via standard promo flow if within 30 days.

recruiter.ops: If internal move creates a backfill req, start it now and flag it as "internal pending". Recruiting can start screening but no offers until promo completes.

carla.eng: Great. Anything to watch with benefits enrollment if effective date changes?

maya.hr: Benefits coverage changes often hinge on payroll effective date. If benefit eligibility depends on active FTE on first of month, backdating to first helps them be eligible that month. For retro one-day changes, benefits team will adjust enrollment dates; just put desired benefits effective date in the form.

hr-bot: Reminder: small retros <7 days: tag payroll and comp; include GL code and desired benefits effective date.

carla.eng: Thanks. I'll submit with GL and desired benefits start 2025-02-01.

maya.hr: We'll triage and confirm before payroll close. :white_check_mark:
